_readme: Recipes for the ORC-1 panel textures. Commit the recipe, not just the pixels —
these are regenerable, and the prompts are the source of truth.
Generated with the Undici pipeline (~/Desktop/Undici/pipeline), which calls the
OpenAI Images API directly. Run from that directory:
Division of labour: CSS draws geometry (exact circles, crisp rects, precise
gaps); these rasters supply material (grain, knurl, rubber). Gradients fake
microtexture badly, which is what made the panel look flat.
Piano keys are deliberately absent: generated sprites cannot hold pixel-exact
edges or consistent widths across twelve keys. Keybed geometry stays in CSS.

abs_bone.note: Uniform lighting is load-bearing — any gradient survives the seamless heal as a visible bright cross.
abs_bone.prompt: seamless macro texture of matte bone-cream ABS injection-moulded plastic, very fine even matte grain with subtle orange-peel moulding texture, absolutely uniform flat-on lighting, no highlights, no shadows, no edges, no objects, no vignette, no border, fills the entire frame edge to edge

knob_yellow.note: The master cap. Silver and orange are edits of this one so all three share identical knurl geometry — three separate gens would drift.
knob_yellow.prompt: top-down orthographic product photograph of a knurled synthesiser knob cap in matte yellow anodised finish, fine vertical diamond knurling around the rim, flat top face with a single moulded indicator line running from centre to edge, sharp macro detail, even soft studio light, perfectly circular, centred, no perspective

knob_silver.prompt: identical knob, identical knurling, identical framing, identical lighting and identical indicator line — repaint the cap brushed silver aluminium

knob_orange.prompt: identical knob, identical knurling, identical framing, identical lighting and identical indicator line — repaint the cap bright orange-red

grille_slots.note: Deliberately NOT run through seamless: it mirror-blends both axes, which smears a strict stripe pitch. Crop an integer number of slot periods and repeat in CSS instead.
grille_slots.prompt: extreme close-up top-down photograph of fine horizontal slots moulded into a matte cream-bone ABS plastic panel, slots perfectly straight parallel and evenly spaced, soft overhead studio light, shallow moulded relief with subtle shadow inside each slot, flat-on orthographic view, no perspective, no vignette, fills the entire frame edge to edge

pad_rubber.prompt: top-down orthographic photograph of a dark charcoal soft-touch silicone rubber button pad with a gently domed top, matte velvety surface with fine rubber grain, soft broad overhead light with a single diffuse specular on the dome crown, subtle rounded edge falloff, rounded square shape, centred, no perspective
